notes: Node 24 could not be installed (the install was blocked in the sandbox); ran on Node v22.23.5. npm run bootstrap refuses Node < 24, so setup used the documented fallback: git submodule update --init upstream/ffmpeg (39 s), npm ci (7 s), npm run reference:build (3 min 3 s).
sol_probe in the pinned commit returns AVPROBE_SCORE_MAX; the descriptor uses precedence 100 as the registry recipe requires for exact magics.
The bad-tag status is 255 (literal -1 from sol_read_header), not an errno value, so it is host-independent.
Native accepts input -ss on SOL (probed: copy framecrc starts at the first packet with a shortened second packet); the refusal is kept per the spec until mirrored.
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries and the two container registry tests (16) passed.
